notes: Lumina OS — A complete browser-based desktop operating system with a unique visual identity (ethereal light theme with glass morphism, depth, and smooth motion). Features: real window manager (drag, resize, snap, minimize, maximize, focus, z-order, alt-tab), virtual filesystem persisted in localStorage shared across all apps, 10 fully functional built-in apps (Files, Terminal with real command set including pipes/redirection/history/tab-completion, Editor with syntax highlighting/tabs/search, Paint with layers/tools, Music Player with visualizer/playlist, Calendar with month/week/day views, System Monitor with live charts, Browser with tabs/bookmarks, Settings with full persistence, Calculator with basic/scientific/programmer modes). Includes boot sequence, lock screen, launcher with live search, notification center, context menus, keyboard shortcuts, theme/wallpaper/settings persistence, system sounds, and responsive design. All apps genuinely work and share the filesystem. No external dependencies, runs from index.html.
